title.zh: 更新下载速度显著提升

description.en: Updates are now downloaded incrementally, transferring only the content that differs between versions instead of the complete installer. The improvement takes effect from the next update onward.
description.zh: 更新已改为增量下载，仅传输版本之间存在差异的内容，无需重新获取完整安装包。该优化自下一次更新起生效。
